limitations: Catalog membership is separate from available current ephemerides.
Mean elements/periods select sampling cadence only; positions require actual Horizons vectors.
Moon coordinates are parent-body-relative geometric J2000 ecliptic vectors, not heliocentric coordinates.
Missing radii remain null; any renderer fallback must be declared as a display size.
Bounded Hermite display interpolation is not a precision ephemeris or an observation.

The five available TNO-moon predictions use fixed precomputed satellite solutions with historical observation spans and source-reported uncertainties. These are predictions, not new observations; current 2026 accuracy is not established. Their parent-body centers use the same solutions, with earlier barycenter files retained.
catalog_scope: 461 JPL planetary satellites including Earth's Moon plus seven separately NASA/literature-confirmed TNO moons; all records retain ephemeris availability.

midpoint_validation.scope: Separate Horizons non-knot geometric parent-relative KM-S queries; sampled discrepancies only, no global accuracy bound.

tno_center_validation.method: Separately queried Sun-centered KM-S states compared with the sum of primary-body and primary-relative moon vectors, independently sampled at a non-knot UTC time.
tno_center_validation.limitations: Internal source/center/unit/interpolation consistency only, not independent dynamics, an observed position measurement, 2026 prediction accuracy, or a full-interval error bound.
